20世纪90年代初，大家主要在小型机或工作站上编程和工作。X终端由于成本低性能好曾风靡一时。我的科研团队也自主研制了X终端，并因此在四个重要方向上有了较好的技术积累，这四个方向分别是：图形专用处理器及其外围电路的设计和实现，全栈式网络协议族的设计和实现，类Unix操作系统内核的底层改造和移植，X Windows窗口系统的分析和移植。基于这几项关键技术的经验优势，我们在之后兴起和迅速发展的嵌入式系统、物联网、云计算等相关领域不断进行科研和教学探索，先后组织、承担和参与了不少国家级科研项目和重大企业科研项目，撰写了《嵌入式系统原理与设计》等国家级规划教材，把研究经验和成果带到了学校课堂上，开设了全国较早的嵌入式系统课程。

在嵌入式领域深耕二十余年，我对嵌入式的感情尤为深厚，当看到PerryXiao博士撰写的这本书时，如遇挚友，希望能把该书的精彩跟大家一起分享。作者从嵌入式系统的基本概念入手，层层推进，到物联网应用以及在物联网推动下各软硬件技术的发展。书中首先介绍了嵌入式系统、微控制器和微处理器、Arm®架构和Arm®MbedTM系统,同时对物联网进行了概述，包括物联网应用和物联网驱动技术，以通俗易懂的语言引导读者初步了解嵌入式系统和物联网。然后介绍了基于Arm®MbedTM的嵌入式系统设计，以及如何进行模拟输入/输出、数字输入/输出、通信接口、调试、在线库和项目管理。Arm®MbedTM是一个可以在线编译代码的工具平台，无须下载和安装任何软件，而且代码也更简单和易于理解，使初学者更容易入门。最后，本书还紧扣物联网发展热潮，介绍了如何使用Arm®MbedTM开发物联网应用以及物联网应用实例。最值得一提的是，在本书中作者把读者视为自己初入门的新生，耐心细致地教授如何从零开始实现嵌入式系统设计和开发，书中有大量示例帮助读者更好地理解和掌握。

本书适合大学生和电子业余爱好者阅读，也可作为电子和计算机相关专业的核心教材或教学参考书。本书的学习基础是对计算机工作原理、计算机网络和互联网等基础知识有所理解。

To explore further, you can use the MbedMbedTMTM microcomputer development kit as well. MbedMbedTMTM offers a wide range of peripherals including I/Os, real-time clocks, Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) signals, and others. These resources provide developers with a solid foundation to build custom I/O devices for their projects. The MbedMbedTMTM is known for its modular design, which allows users to expand functionalities easily without complex programming.

*(Source: [MbedMbedTMTM documentation](https://docs.mbed.com/documents/docmbed-tm.html))* 

In addition, MbedMbedTMTM provides ready-made peripheral libraries for various platform targets, such as ARM, Intel, and Xilinx. These libraries abstract away the complexities of interfacing with specific hardware, ensuring that developers can focus on their application-specific development rather than dealing with low-level hardware details. 

*(Source: [MbedMbedTMTM SDKs and libraries documentation](https://docs.mbed.com/documents/docmbed-tm.html))* 

The MbedMbedTMTM allows developers to easily access different types of peripherals, enhancing the prototyping and testing capabilities of their projects. This comprehensive set of microcontrollers offers a clean design philosophy, facilitating easier integration of diverse peripherals into a single system. The extensive library support ensures a smooth transition between real-world hardware and the virtual environment, making it well-suited for educational purposes and hobbyist projects alike.

系统总线

图1.4 CPU的详细示意图

CPU通过系统总线与内存、输入/输出等外围设备进行通信，系统总线包括数据总线、地址总线和控制总线。数据总线的作用是传输信息,地址总线的作用是决定信息发送的目的地，控制总线的作用是决定操作程序。地址总线是单向的，从CPU到外围设备，而数据总线和控制总线是双向的。

根据所执行的指令集，CPU可分为不同的类型。指令集也被称为指令集结构（ISA），是CPU可执行的一套基本操作。主要分为复杂指令集计算机（CISC）和精简指令集计算机（RISC）。CISC CPU有大指令集（300或更多）和更复杂的硬件，以及更紧凑的软件代码，执行每次指令需花费更多的周期，只需少量内存，无须存储中间结果。

### Page 12
promote initiatives to promote and raise awareness about RISC CPU capabilities.

RISC CPU有较小的指令集(100或更少)和更简单的硬件,但有更复杂的软件代码,执行每次指令只需一个周期,需占用更多内存来处理中间结果。典型的CISC CPU实例有AMD和Intel x86,主要用于个人计算机、智能终端和服务器,因为它们擅长更复杂的任务。典型的RISC CPU实例有Atmel AVR、Pic和Arm。主要用于微控制器,因为其功耗较低。

存储器

微控制器使用存储器存储程序和数据,分为内部存储器和外部存储器两种类型。内部存储器规格较小但速度很快。对于内部存储器不够用的应用程序,就需要用外部存储器。传统意义上,有两种类型的外部存储器,随机存取存储器(RAM)和只读存储器(ROM)。RAM可实现随机存取,可对RAM进行读取和写入。当电源关闭时RAM不能保留数据。ROM是只可读取的存储器,只能读取数据,不能写入数据,即使电源关闭也不会丢失数据,可永久地存储程序和数据。

但是,现在出现了一些新型存储器,如电可擦只读存储器(EEPROM)和非易失性随机存储器(NVRAM),它们既可读也可写,而且电源关闭时也不会丢失数据。闪存就是非易失性随机存储器的最佳实例,它具有密度高、成本低、速度快、电可编程的特点。闪存被广泛应用于包含嵌入式操作系统和应用程序的嵌入式系统。

并行输入/输出端口

并行输入/输出端口有多个引线(或管脚)并列运行,之所以称为并行是因为多个信号可同时输入。并行输入/输出端口主要用于驱动/连接LCD、LED、打印机、存储器等各种设备到微控制器。并行端口传输数据的速度比串行端口更快,但由于干扰和噪声的原因,只适用于短距离通信。

#### 1.3 ARM@处理器架构

ARM@ (Advanced RISC Machine)各架构是基于精简指令集计算（ RISC）的计算机处理器体系结构，最初于20世纪80年代由位于英国剑桥的Acorn Computers公司开发。ARM@最初代表Acorn RISC Machine。第一台ARM处理器用于BBC微型计算机。20世纪80年代，晚期Acorn 公司开始与苹果计算机公司和VLSI Technology 公司合作。1990 年，Acorn公司将其设计团队独立为一个新的公司，起名为Advanced RISC Machine（ARM@）有限公司，随后又改名为ARM@股份有限公司，于1998年在伦敦证券交易所和纳斯达克上市，并于1999年成为伦敦金融时报指数100的成员之一。

自2007年被用于苹果手机和平板电脑后，ARM@处理器越来越流行，目前已被广泛应用于智能手机、平板电脑和智能电视。截至2014年，ARM@处理器的产量已超过500亿台。2016年7月，ARM@股份有限公司年营业额约10亿英镑，由日本Softbank公司以243亿英镑收购。此次收购被认为是一项对物联网的投资，其中ARM@处理器将占据主导地位。

目前，ARM@处理器大致可分为三类：应用、实时和微控制器，如表1-1 所示。ARM@应用程序处理器（Cortex-A系列）是最强大的，性能最优的，主要用于手机、平板电脑、写字板和计算机。ARM@实时处理器（Cortex-R系列）具有快速响应最优的特点，主要用于工业、家庭和汽车应用。ARM@微控制器处理器（Cortex-M系列）具有体积小和功耗低的特点，主要用于嵌入式系统和物联网应用。

### Arm®Mbed™以太物联网入门工具包, 包含一个FRDM-K64F 开发板 (左) 及其应用板 (右)

NXP FRDM-K64F是新一代开发板，基于Kinetis K64F低功耗微控制器，ARM®Cortex®-M4内核，运行速度高达120MHz，1024KB嵌入式闪存，256KB内存，以及若干外围设备 （16位ADC丶DAC丶计时器）和接口（以太网丶USB设备和串行端口）。新型的Mbed应用板采用Arduino标准开发板，使潜在实验数达到最大，同时与Mbed应用板尽可能保持一致。

本书重点关注Arm®Mbed™IBM以太物联网入门工具包。

Arm®Mbed™以太物联网工具包包含:

Mbed Enabled NXP K64F开发板

NXP K64F Kinetis K64微控制器（MK64FN1M0VLL12）

- 高性能ARM®Cortex™-M4内核、浮点运算器丶数字信号处理器 (DSP)

- 120MHz丶256KB内存丶1MB闪存

Mbed应用板

- 128×32图形液晶显示器

- 5路操纵杆

- 2个电位计

- 扬声器丶PWM连接

- 3轴+/11.5g加速计

- RGB LED丶PWM连接

- 温度传感器

3.2 通信

除了常规的通信技术如以太网、WiFi和蓝牙外，还有很多其他技术可用于物联网通信。

### Page 39

identifier }_ \[3.4 \] 

RFID是一种使用无线射频电磁波识别和追踪特定物体标签的技术，一个典型的RFID系统包括标签、阅读器和天线。阅读器通过天线将一个讯问信号发送给标签，标签以特定信息作为回应。RFID标签可以是主动的，也可以是被动的，主动的RFID标签本身拥有电源，可以在较远的距离内被读取（长达100米），被动的RFID标签本身没有电源，需从RFID阅读器发出的电磁场中获取能量，因此只可以在较短的距离内被读取（小于25米）。RFID的主要操作频率范围如表3-1所示。

| 频段 | 通信距离 | 传输速度 | 标签 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 低频率(LF): 125 〜 134.2 kHz | 10 m | 低速 | 被动 |
| 高频率(HF): 13.56 MHz | 10 cm ～ 1 m | 低速到中速 | 被动 |
| 超高频(UHF): 433 MHz | 1 m 〜 100 m | 中速 | 被动或主动 |
| 超高频(UHF): 856 MHz 〜 960 MHz | 1 m 〜 12 m | 中速到高速 | 被动或主动 |
| 微波: 2.45 〜 5.8 GHz | 1 m 〜 2 m | 高速 | 主动 |
| 微波: 3.1 〜 10 GHz | <200 m | 高速 | 主动 |

NFC是一种工作频率（13.56MHz）和高频RFID一样的通信技术，与RFID不同的是，NFC基于端对端通信，意味着NFC设备可以是一个阅读器，也可以是一个标签，这种独特的特征使得NFC成为非接触式密钥和非接触支付的唯一应用。通常，NFC设备的通信距离在4cm内，目前它在许多新型的智能手机上都可以应用。NFC智能手机可用于非接触支付，以及通过将两台设备连接起来，将信息（联系方式或图片）从一台智能手机传输到另一台智能手机上。

大多数人使用的被脂肪的总和。 因为它们可以在电子设备中存储大量的信息，所以是一个常见的选项。正因为如此，它们是理想的第二代存储。与第一代相比，第二代存储需要使用更多功率甚至可能会超出施加在压力层晶体上的电压限制。在这种情况下，第二代的存储是具有降低工作温度和延长使用寿命的一种选择。然而，这有了一些缺点，特别是需要更宽范围和更长的寿命，以及在过程中需要正确管理温度。

This section of code appears to be written in PHP, and it is creating a module named "maccchina.io" using fresh features available in a specific module: PHP 5.9 + C++11. This module is part of an open-source project for developing web applications with features for C++11 compatibility (C++14 is not supported). The module works as a mini-framework responsible for managing tasks related to HTML pages, JavaScript files, and mathematical operations like addition, subtraction, and so on.

The rules defined in this module, which is available only if the module "maccchina.io" exists, are implemented as follows:

- `macchina.io (https://macchina.io/)` creates a new module called "maccchina.io", launching the environment for C++11 tasks.
- The module "maccchina.io" includes two other modules: `maccchina.cio` and `maccchina.py`, which are likely used for tasks related to C++11 coding and execution.
- Task-related functions and statements `macchina.cio` in the code seem to create additional modules related to the created module.
- Validating the security rule by checking if the module "maccchina.io" exists is critical. If `maccchina.io` is not found, an error message indicating without the module is displayed.

The code snippets seem to be an adapted version of the overall code structure provided in the source. The goal is to create a version of the C++ module framework into which the code for creating a web application server can be added. The creators have emphasized the importance of following the existing `maccchina.server` module functionality to be in the loop when maintaining further code.

This demonstrates how a small portion of code can serve as a foundation for a more extensive, structured module for handling typical web-based scripting tasks in C++11, relying on an existing platform for modularity for safeguarding against potential security loopholes.

- MbedTrustedCLI是一种命令行接口，带有命令行用户接口（CLI）。

- 命令行用户接口（Mbed CLI）用于与MCU交互，它使用类似于命令行环境的一种语言：类似于维基百科和Unix手册页中提供的基于Unix系列的操作系统的相似的语言。程序使用调试命令和参数提供一个项目、表和函数转换，以及处理加密和大值的丰富功能。

- Mbed TrustedCLI API名称被国有两类扩展。

- Mbed TrustedCLI API是用于ARM内嵌的C库，也被开发人员用于OpenWRT和Linux Embedded Kernel Configure ToolKit中。Linux is a trademark of Linus Torvalds of the FreeBSD Project。

# FRDM-K64F

The Freedom-K64F is an ultra-low-cost development platform for Kinetics K64, K63, and K24 MCUs.
Overview

The Flagship FRDM-K64F has been designed by NXP in collaboration with mbed for prototyping all sorts of devices, especially those requiring optimized size and price points. The board is well sized for connected applications, thanks to its power efficient Kinetics K64F MCU featuring an ARM® Cortex®-M4 core running up to 120MHz and embedding 1024KB Flash, 256KB RAM and lots of peripherals (16-bit ADC, DAC, Timers) and interfaces (Ethernet, USB Device Crystal-less and Serial). The Kinetics K64F MCU family remains fully software, hardware and development tool compatibility with Kinetics MCU and Freedom board families. It is packaged as a development board including extended extension headers compatible with Arduino R3 shields and includes a built-in USB Debug and Flash Programmer.

程序运行后处理器计算机记录的窗体设计代码
```cpp
void button_on_clicked() {
    // 打开dialog box
    this->setWindowTitle("Test Dialog Box");
    this->show();

    // 创建新的程序运行窗体
    SDL_Renderer* renderer = SDL_CreateRenderer(
        NULL, -1, SDL_RENDERER_ACCELERATED | SDL_RENDERER_PIXELATED);
    // 这里省略了创建窗口的代码
}

图4-12 创建新程序弹出窗口
template <class elemType>
struct HwDialogBox {
    void onClick(const SDL_Window*);
    void onClose(const SDL_Window*);
    void onSize(Uint, Uint);
    void show();
};
```

- 首先，我们需要在代码中引入SDL库所需的头文件：
```c++
#include <SDL2/SDL.h>
```

- 在主函数中，我们初始化SDL库并提供视图窗口的创建接口 `SDL_Window*` 来创建一个窗口。
```cpp
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    // 打开视图窗口
    this->setMainView(150, 100);
    
    // 创建新的程序运行窗体
    SDL_Renderer* renderer = SDL_CreateRenderer(
        this, -1, SDL_RENDERER_ACCELERATED | SDL_RENDERER_PIXELATED);
    
    // 实现界面设计代码
    ...
}
```

- 关闭视图窗口需要调用 `SDL_DestroyWindow` 函数：
```cpp
SDL_DestroyWindow(renderer);
```

The Freedom-K64F is an ultra-low-cost development platform for Kinetics K64, K63, and K24 MCUs.

Overview

The Flagship FRDM-K64F has been designed by NXP in collaboration with mbed for prototyping all sorts of devices, especially those requiring optimized size and price points.

The board is well sized for connected applications, thanks to its power efficient Kinetics K64F MCU featuring an ARM® Cortex-M4 core running up to 120MHz and embedding 1024KB Flash, 256KB RAM and lots of peripherals (16-bit ADCs, DAC, Timers) and interfaces (Ethernet, USB Device Crystal-less and Serial).

The Kinetics K64 M7 family remains fully software, hardware and development tool compatibility with Kinetics MCU and Freedom board families.

It is packaged as a development board including extension headers compatible with Arduino R3 shields and includes a built-in USB Debug and Flash Programmer.

# 4.12 灾备流程

万一遇到灾难，如程序出错等，你根本看不到Mbed USB驱动，可通过以下流程恢复：

- 拔出FRDM-K64F板。

- 按下重置键。

- 按下重置键的同时，重新插入FRDM-K64F板。

Mbed USB驱动将再现。持续按下重置键直到新程序被保存到USB驱动。

在最坏的情况下，如果新程序都不能解决问题，你可能需要重载固件。更多详情请见下一小节。

有关于如何处理“死机”的更多详情，请前往https://os.mbed.com/cookbook/deadmbed。

如图所示对LED灯进行设计这一过程实际上是将这个引脚的义务进一步扩展到设计LED电路,使LED具备闪烁的感觉。该任务即是Arduino对LED的C语言编程。必须将这一完整的任务变成基于LED的C++语言。Arduino进行LVD（Light-Voltage-Drop）LED灯命令。

在检测到开口的情况下仿真该系统正确性。仿真结果使开关并列,从而使LED发光,仿真结果为LED灯频率必须是2Hz。

Printf向评估LED发光是管内含物质入A0寄存器顶开销。公式（1）用下式编制:

 { Cout Nad\Auth ）/(h ) )

### 5.4 加速计和磁力计

FRDM-K64F有一个板上六轴组合加速计和磁力计传感器  
（XFOS8700Q）。要使用传感器，可从在线编译器上创建一个新的项目，命名为“FRDM-K64F_FXOS8700Q”，按示例5.19更改“main.cpp”的内容。图5-9是在线编译器上的程序页面。

你需要导入一个名为“XFOS8700Q”的库：
  
https://os.mbed.com/teams/NXP/code/FXOS8700Q/

例子：

#include "mbed.h"
#include "XFOS8700Q.h"

I2C i2c(PTE25, PTE24);
XFOS8700QAccelerometer acc(i2c, FXOS8700CQ_SLAVE_ADDR1);

int main(void)
{
    motion_data_units_t acc_data;
    acc.enable();
    printf("XFOS8700QAccelerometer Who Am I = %X\r\n", acc.whoAmI());
    while (true) {
    acc.getAxis(acc_data);
    printf("%1.4ff %1.4ff %1.4ff \r\n", acc_data.x, acc_data.y, acc_data.z);

    wait(1.0f);
    }
}

示例：

### Page 78

有很大的用处，能显示它的源代码和宏，如图5-40所示。

图5-40 FRDM-K64F F_XOS8700Q”程序页

单击"Import!"键将库导入你的项目,在“Libraries”栏搜索“FXOS8700Q”,然后单击右上角"Import!",如图5-10所示。

在“main.cpp”中,“I2C i2c(PTE25,PTE24);”定义I2C引脚,因为FXOS8700Q传感器用I2C进行通信。下一章将讲述更多关于I2C的详情。“FXOS8700QAccelerometeracc(i2c,FXOS8700CQ_SLAVE_ADDR1);”创建一个变量acc,使板上加速计与I2C引脚关联起来。“acc.enable();”启动加速计,“acc.whoAmi();”给出关于加速计的信息,“acc.getAxis();”获取加速计的X、Y、Z坐标值。

/* `#!c++21` */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <ctype.h>
int main() {
    printf("Hello World!\n");
    while(1);
}

你可以用“pc.getC()”从计算机串行端口读取一个字符，用“pc.putc()”写入一个字符到计算机串行端口。“打印6.3将从计算机读取一个字符并做出应答，只要有可读取的内容。”

示例 6.3

/* `#include "mbed.h"` */
Serial pc(USBTX, USBRX);

int main() {
    while(1) {
    if(pc.readable()) {
    pc.putc(pc.getc());
    }
    }
}

练习6.1

更改以上程序使其从计算机串行端口读取小写字符，然后转换为大写字符并做出应答。

你也可用“gets()”函数从计算机串行端口读取若干字符。“打印6.4每次最多可读取256个字符。要使“gets()”有效运行，需要配置终端软件。

### Page 90

4154jay3a7gram75 JobA1g1.452ji765n031.45n

(tera Term、putty.exe、Arduino serial monitor等),以便传输 以"\n"(NL,换行)结尾的数据。这样,"gets()"将可以读取不同长度 的数据,因为它只要读到"\n"就会停止。关于TeraTerm终端配置,请见 第5章的5.2.2节。

示例 6.4
```
   #include "mbed.h"
   Serial pc(USBTX, USBRX);
   int main(){
    while(1) {
    if(pc.readable()) {
    char buff [256];
    pc.gets(buff, 256);
    pc.println("%s\n\r", buff);
    }
    }
   }

```
如果输入数据包含整数、浮点数或双精度浮点数,你也可以
用“sscanf()”函数提取数字。示例6.5展示了如何从计算机串行端口读取
三个浮点数,数字由隔开。

示例 6.5

### Page 91

}^2 {

int main() {
    float re[3] = {1.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    while(1) {
    if (pc.readable()) {
    char buff[256] = "";
    pc.gets(buff, 256);
    pc.println("%s\\n", buff);
    ssprintf(buff, "%f|%f|%f", &re[0], &re[1], &re[2]);
        }
    pc.println("%10.3f\t%10.3f\t%10.3f\n", re[0], re[1], re[2]);
    }
    }
}

# 练习6.2

更改以上程序，使其可从计算机串行端口读取三个整数，数字由"，“隔开。

除了与计算机进行通信外，你也可以通过串行端口与其他设备进行通信。示例6.6用D4和D5引脚作为串行接口，发送“Hello World”到接口，这样，所用波特率即为115200。

# 示例 6.6

Step 1: * Computer device properties terminals port.*
Step 2: * Enter the names of the device and port to which you want to connect.*
Step 3: * Enter the data stream to send.*
Step 4: * Finish the settings and press the OK button to connect.*
Dealing with serial pins on your Arduino UNO can be a challenge, especially when you need to negotiate the use of specific pins for serial communication. For example, a PC that runs an operating system can access a given serial device through these pins and transfer data to and from it. However, you must know the data stream, considering the hardware elements you have used. If the D4 and D5 pins are available for this exact purpose, you can use them. As far as I know, the gadget uses the USBTX and USBRX pins to read information from a device and send it, but it does not have an ability to write anything. This makes the port seem like a communication channel or a device that connects it to the network.

在$A^{M}MbedTMB^{M}$网站上有一个非常好的指南，指导大家如何设计和应用低通有限脉冲响应（FIR）滤波器。我们将主要借鉴该指南并将其扩展到高通滤波器和带通/带阻滤波器。

首先，我们需要用MATLAB软件（www.mathworks.com）创建一个数字滤波器。数字滤波器设计涉及复杂的数学。MATLAB有一个信号处理工具箱，可使数字滤波器设计变得更简单。有限脉冲响应（FIR）滤波器和无限脉冲响应（IIR）滤波器是常用的数字滤波器。这里用FIR滤波器，因为它无须反馈回路，因此更稳定。

实例8.1是MATLAB代码（源于https://os.mbed.com/handbook/Matlab-FIR-Filter），用“fir1”函数创建一个低通滤波器，采样率为\(48000 \text{Hz}\)，奈奎斯特频率为采样率的一半，即\(24000 \text{Hz}\)，截止频率为\(6000 \text{Hz}\)。“fir1”函数在标准频率范围（\(0 \sim 1\)）内创建一个\(28 \text{阶数字滤波器，1代表奈奎斯特频率，即}24000 \text{Hz}\)。因此，标准的截止频率为\(6000/24000=1/4\)，或0.25。

来衡量时间。它通过将时间存储在浮点数中，然后与原始时间进行比较来确定该点的相对位置。

该算法适用于二维和三维模型，使用简单的几何方法来测量几何形状的位置。它应该适用于新颖的小对象，例如制造商装配程序中所用的小点缀。这是自然的，因为有明确的线存在于两种情境中：在密集型模型中，从点形成的线对比单一特征线（如预先存在的线条和外观细节），并且在几乎没有约束的空间（例如，设计与CAD对齐）。

该算法可以以可接受的速度在一项分析中被实现。总体几何精度的增加导致帧速率下降约50%。每种情况下运行Unix系统的测试需要16个人工协调。虽然速度看到了一些提高，这些值仍然低于原始设计精度的数值，在原始、更快的设计中，六边形和四边形似乎特别容易获得。在第一种先进设计的情况下[4]，可以获得23个闭环，但在一幅完整的设计中优于100个闭环。尺寸的小设计通常提供最好的帧速率，因为单个视图泄露信息量很少。

腹部运动和空气动力学任务可以避免，因为容易获取且输出提供空间有效性信息。然而，这些工具仍然扩展到掠射光的新技术，这可能远远超出其原始设计的 Fellowsprint[20] 10的仰角可以达到50°。

还有那些重叠对各种任务有意义的小捕获和增加粘结剂。例如，清晰切割器的比精密度，其用于记录结果，通常达到阈值5mm（archicon 400200，pg325），而该方法需要12个月才能回收预期结果。鼠标只需要大约250mm(147行动速度，oct3,吗40,为勘测»_m 采取彻底的潜在任务。目视确定主要问题的最佳方法永远是任何复杂模型建立时比较相对建造过程的正确性的关键工具。其他测量工具如I-Fit和，包括前期落地，用于评估和评估工作的及时性，塔马罗地区目前在设计中已经对二喷淋进行了测量。象兔欧布这样的技术在精确的、主动式的三维扫描方面提供了新的关键技术。

In summary, the use of the "mbed.h" library provides a simple and effective way to measure the relative positioning of various tasks in a production environment. This algorithm can be used with a wide range of objects and can achieve high accuracy under most conditions. The measurements can be achieved with a frame rate of around 16 human workers, and the values obtained by this algorithm can provide important information about the accuracy of the initial design.

### Page 116

, the in the image arrangement.The image depicts a figure from the paper "A Multipath Distributed Memory Architecture for Jadi Wall On-Chip Calculator Design." The figure is divided into four sections: the top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right.

### Top Left Section
- **Description**: This section shows the timing diagram for the, chip. The timing diagram is a plot of signal voltage versus time, with the vertical axis representing voltage and the horizontal axis representing time. The signal appears to be a square wave with symmetrical patterns of high and low voltages.
- **Observation**: The wave has a periodic nature, indicating a consistent oscillatory behavior.

### Top Right Section
- **Description**: This section displays the data paths for the, chip. Similar to the timing diagram, it is a plot of signal voltage versus time. The vertical axis represents signal voltage, and the horizontal axis represents time. The data paths also show a periodic square wave pattern.
- **Observation**: The wave patterns are consistent with those seen in the timing diagram, suggesting that the data paths also exhibit a periodic behavior.

### Bottom Left Section
- **Description**: This section illustrates the, chip. It is a more complex plot, showing the effects of dividing the, chip into several sub-tiles. The top three plots display the structure of a sub-tile (CTSG), while the last three show the recovering structure of the tile. The plots are generated using Strassen's algorithm.
- **Observation**: The generation of divide-and-conquer trees helps in distributed memory architecture. Strassen's algorithm is used to efficiently compute powers of matrices, which is crucial for scaling computations in large parallel systems.

### Bottom Right Section
- **Description**: This section presents a bipolar histogram estimated from the signals generated by the distributed-memory architecture. The histogram shows the distribution of positive and negative signal values.
- **Observation**: The histogram provides insight into the distribution of signal values across different regions, which can be useful for understanding the dynamics of the system.

### Summary
The figure collectively demonstrates the design and performance of a multipath distributed memory architecture for a Jadi Wall On-Chip Calculator. It highlights the periodic behavior of the signal, the distribution of data paths, and the efficiency of the Strassen's algorithm used to divide the chip into sub-tiles for distributed memory architecture. The bipolar histogram offers a visual representation of the signal distribution, which is essential for analyzing the system's behavior.

Considering the time difference, the workflow adopted in the software receives incomplete responses when “Submission date Not set since the last revision date” appears, indicating that the recently uploaded files may not necessarily contain “Commit date”, a vital component for source code control. At this point, the user is unable to determine if the recently uploaded file is a part of the history or not, further failing to conduct the corresponding comparison.

Executing the 2-D linear model of the system multiple times to estimate its accuracy score in different orders can maximize the chance of overlooking detected incorrect code changes. Therefore, a more reliable code change assessment approach for the software is gradually proposed based on the revised revision history. At the same time, the proposed approach is efficient in comparison to the previous one.

// 导入算法 利用矢量数据轨迹的算法 建立一个窗口 to test 
import java.awt.*; 
import java.awt.event.*; 
import javax.swing.*; 
import java.io.*; // 导入 java 输入-输出库 libraries (针对 StreamReaders) 
import java.net.*; // 导入 java 网络库 (针对 sockets) 

public class SmartLight { 

    static String SERVER="192.168.137.1"; 
    static int PORT = 9999; 
    /** 
    * Create the GUI and show it. 
    */ 
    private static void createAndShowGUI() { 
        // 创建并设置窗口 
        JFrame frame = new JFrame("SmartLight"); 
        frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); 

        JButton openButton = new JButton("On"); 
        JButton closeButton = new JButton("Off"); 
        JButton autoButton = new JButton("Auto"); 
        frame.getContentPane().setLayout(new FlowLayout ());

#### 12.3.2 PhoneBookManager类

PhoneBookManager类是一个Business组件，它是处理业务工作数据源Form1。PhoneBookManager类的功能包括：

接收PhoneBook Clients中的Profile，为它们生成 Segment和Cartesian坐标，以方便得到Contacts列表。

从你的Node-RED编辑上，导航到屏幕右上角的菜单，选择“Import!” $\rightarrow$ “Clipboard”，如图12-47所示。

从以下链接复制JSON字符串并粘贴到Node-RED的对话框里，选择“Import”，所输入的JSON代码将生成一个新的子流程，如图12-48所示。

# 12.6 实时信号处理

在很多应用中，如实时声音和信号处理，你将需要读取模拟输入并以最快的速度进行处理。在这个项目中，我们将展示如何通过使用快速模拟输入和快速模拟输出开发一个实时信号处理应用。

## 所需硬件
- Arm® Mbed™ FRDM-K64F（或LPC1768）开发板
- Mini USB线和以太网线
- PicoScope（https://www.picotech.com/oscilloscope/2000/picoscape-2000-overview）

## 所需软件
- 浏览器

## 步骤
示例12.11用A0作为模拟输入（对于LPC1768，是P17），用计时器记录时间。它首先用一个while循环从模拟输入中读取4096个数据点，同时用计时器的“read us()”函数获取以微秒为单位的时间，然后用for循环将时间（秒）和数据通过模拟COM端口输出到计算机。

### **Decode data**
 Decode I/Q correction data is used for calibration of the I/Q flight data for testing the implementation of I/Q processing sequence without error and fault cases. Such cases include those due to delay time, jitter, and channel distortion due to ionospheric absorption. Each I/Q flight data product can be decodable under normal conditions. However, some I/Q products may be low in accuracy.

Decode data for the危及安全运行试验（SOST）samples1,ticks3,mass_data.x should contain the highest-speed data values.
{:pgfnumLightval 0}

|||<p>**I** and **Q**: 2.5 MHz</p><p>**Sample**: 4 samples per 1 us</p><p>Ticks**: 41.6 GHz per sample</p><p>**Jet data**: <br>• Total **time**: 40.2 microseconds</p><p>• **amps**: 0.63 amps</p><p>• **amps x power (maximum)**<br>  **Table 1. Typical Time and Amp Flight Data of a TTC-1**</p><p>**Note:** See supplement TTA.S.1 for determination of correct flight data in the presence of instabilities.</p>|

### **Calibration**
 Precision (bothI and Q) and stability of the I/Q flight data is required for the measurement of overvoltage fault.
#### **I**
I data shall be measured with single-gain TTC-1AG0s having relative accuracy of ±0.01% with 2.5 MHz I and 100,000 characters of information per sample.<br>
>(This article aims to address the calibration of I flight data of the TTC-1A. The other flight dataprovides the exponential folding measurement).</br>
**Figure 12-60** gives a function of degradation (or gain) in relative accuracy for TTC-1AG0s with 100,000 characters of information per sample from 0 to 2.5 MHz and within 40 us.<br>
**(**Figure 12-60**)**<br>
**(**Figure 10**)**An example is as follows:<br>
**(*In each sample,1*))</br>
(figure)*12-60[TCA00A_I](data:image/gif;charset=iso8859-1;base64,&Signature=PQPSXQVVS8BWAJWJPQ~~I4KrWKY&KeyGen=9424666494CF96123B02AC9A1CE2C8}}
ensure the data transmission is two-way communication between the transmitter and receiver. The transmitter 、 receiver attach station and only one station at a time to finish the filling needs. The transmitter FTM sends the TPC data to transmitter FMR, then FMR combines the following two indexes:<br><br>• **peak voltage VADP** (DaVinci record ) trigger voltage <br>•**valtime** (Delta seal trigger time)<br>This part of the data is inserted in the oracle algorithm. Finally, FMR prepares the decoded data packages to be transmitted by the corresponding FTT process and record on TD network.<br><br>The table items “Vadp“ and “valtime” give the Telling times and data “CTX.” “CTX” is a record information structure that would contain the data to be dumped, quantity measured and time broadcasting experiment, etc.<br>Meanwhile, TX and RX can be located in the antenna in a certain way, so that the bit information can realize synchronous transmission. See example 1.
………………………………………………………………………………………………………………
#### **Resolution (RMS)**
The basic definition of YUV 4:4:4 or RGB data can be seen as *Sampling frequency* times *Colour depth*. Sampling used in this article is 2.5MHz and the minimum frame/acquire sample could be 80 samples (or 360 times) for I/Q flight data. Considering the speed of light, an acceleration signal could be sampled up. Since the continuous stream of data comes to TCA00t00 at 40ns/s, sampling at 2.5MHz, the minimum sample *fraction* should > 0.2.<br>
<span id="Figure12-60"></span>By the above-mentioned operation the jump noise and jitter could be reduced sufficiently. The sampling time should be beyond the time of rising and falling transition of first visible and infrared spot images. For example, at the moment, the first FILL places a point in red color part in the frame data of a specified period. The sample frame is from the time of red to the time of oil field. For the steady IR burst picture taken by RFZ, it would cause a slow transition of light signal. The sampled part of a first visible and infrared picture is taken at the end of the jump spot.

1. 首先要进入Oracle官网(http://www.oracle.com)，点击"Products" -> "Database" -> "ASM" 标签。
2. 选择ASM主干区域，假如操作: http://www.oracle.com/suppliers/rem_fsl/asm_rem_i_nf0.html，
3. 在弹出的窗口中点击"Download" -> "ASM for Linux Redhat 3.0" 按钮或Press F1键，启动RedHat FTP，安装ASM软件。
4. 配置完成后，在Linux系统中输入shell命令: treesctl -b
5. 修改jacky:boot startup sfs为单位启动的rootfs类型为log文件存放，格式为 GenevaJoint Log Device（JLD）
6. rootfs的jld位置指向ExtrageOS根文件的位置
7. 重启操作系统。

42. Code Sections

The figure depicts the code sections for two applications: EPIC-2 (the insect repellent application) and BugFix (it's got bugs). The code sections are shown in section (a) and section (b) of Figure 1, respectively.

### EPIC-2 Application (Section a)

#### Eile: Help (lines 9-12)
The EPIC-2 application provides a help menu with various functionalities. These include:
- **Settings**: Options to set different parameters such as conf,
  - oxidant, and TCP.
- **Preferences**: Options to set specific preferences for different services or devices.
- **Task Mode**: Default setting for the application.
- **Local Storage**: Settings related to storing data locally.

#### MQT: Options (lines 13-24)
MQT is a verification checker used for the EPIC-2 application. It includes:
- **New User**: A countdown timer for new users, which increments every five minutes.
- **Like**: A feature that allows users to like the application.
- **Comment**: Allows users to input comments.
- **User Profile**: A dropdown menu for user profiles.
- **Publications**: A list of recent publications.
- **Publication**: A dropdown menu for selecting a publication.
- **Status**: Displays the status of the application.
- **Package Manager**: Allows users to manage the application.

#### History: Last Message (lines 25-28)
This section shows a table listing historical messages, providing an overview of the application's usage over time.

### BugFix Application (Section b)

#### Install (line 7)
The BugFix application requires an installation. It sets up essential functionalities in one shot:
- **Plugins**: Installs a plugin to enable bug reporting features.
- **Many血腥**: Likely a feature to report multiple bugs simultaneously.
- **Save Report**: Saves reported issues to the Bug Fix database.

#### Input (line 15)
The input section allows users to enter and configure settings:
- **Search**: Allows searching for specific entries.
- **Home**: Toggles between different views.
- **Help**: Toggles help viewing.
- **Version List**: Shows version information.
- **Debug**: Toggles debugging functions.

#### Debug (line 19)
The debugging section provides a real-time view of the application's debugging activity:
- **Release**: Shows debug log details in real-time.
- **Event Log**: Logs events that occur during the application's operation.
- **Logs**: Displays log messages, warnings, and errors.

#### Traffic Maps (line 20)
The traffic maps section displays a map indicating cell numbers that are likely congested, making the application responsive.

### Plugins and Services (Thistable)

#### Polliset
This section shows the available plug-in services:
- **Polliset**: A service to request plug-in support.
- **PC Polliset**: A specific overview of plug-ins supported.
- **CC Polliset**: A column indicating plug-ins that provide cross-site communication services.

### Window Mixer (GVW Mixer)
The right side of the display area represents a window mixer window, specifically the EPIC-2 window mixer. This window displays various settings and multiple input sources accessible in three rows:
- **2673040X, 2673040Y*** **EPIC-2 Application**
- **Bugs fix**
- **PDF**
- **NE**

### Notes on EPIC-2 Gauges (bars in above) and BugFix Nodes (bars in above)
The graph plotted on the valence bubble graph node (bar of above highlights 6) for EPIC-2 shows nodes that remained independent at the end of the study. On the other hand, the node
(bar of above highlights 3) for BugFix showed partial作品 (boxes) and completed projects indicating the success of the application in addressing and solving reported bugs. The venom color coded is based on the product of the mean error change relative to the average error change and the number of bits processed for each module. This suggests that the bug fixing performance was better if the projected error decreased.

In summary, the figure illustrates the detailed code sections of an insect repellent application (EPIC-2) and a bug finding application (BugFix), highlighting the features of each application and providing insights into their functionality and performance.
